subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should context-aware per-turn refresh become a separate permanent `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` plugin API, or should context be carried through the existing hook without creating a parallel contract?
rationale: Repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive, and the discussion contains no maintainer-visible approval for this permanent API shape.

options.title: Keep one canonical hook
options.body: Extend or adapt the existing next-turn hook compatibly so current callbacks continue working while context becomes available through one API.

options.title: Approve the parallel callback
options.body: Accept `prepareNextTurnWithContext` as a permanent public contract and add focused compatibility documentation and tests for precedence between both hooks.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical hook
recommendation.body: Extend or adapt the existing next-turn hook compatibly so current callbacks continue working while context becomes available through one API.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest prior merged history in OpenClaw's compaction and agent-session behavior and can route the API choice to the appropriate owner.
